title: Arrivederci, Fiero
novel:
Ted's [[car|car]] — a [[beat-up|beat-up]] 1981 Fiero he had [[affectionately|affectionate]] named "The [[Beast|Beast]]" — was dying. The [[odometer|odometer]] had [[stopped|stop]] working at 197,000 miles three years ago. It made a [[mysterious|mysterious]] [[clunking|clunk]] noise whenever it turned left. The [[passenger|passenger]] seat was held together with [[duct tape|duct tape]].

"Time to let it go," Marshall said. "It's had a good life."

"You don't [[understand|understand]]," Ted said. "This car has been with me for everything." He [[leaned|lean]] against the [[hood|hood]] and [[remembered|remember]]. His first date with Robin. The road trip to [[Chicago|Chicago]] where they ran out of [[gas|gas]] and had to [[push|push]] the car three miles. The night Lily left for San Francisco and Ted drove Marshall around for hours because he could not stop [[crying|cry]].

"A car is more than a [[machine|machine]]," Ted said. "It's a [[time machine|time machine]]."

The gang helped Ted [[clean|clean]] out the Fiero one last time. Under the seats, they found a [[library|library]] of lost [[artifacts|artifact]]: Robin's old [[earring|earring]], Barney's lucky [[tie|tie]], Lily's [[painting|paint]] of a [[dolphin|dolphin]] she had done in college, and Marshall's [[diploma|diploma]] that he thought he had lost forever.

"OK," Ted said finally, [[locking|lock]] the car for the last time. "Arrivederci, Fiero."

"That's Italian for 'goodbye,'" Barney said. "Which I know because I am very [[cultured|culture]]."

"You Googled it," Robin said.

"I Googled it," Barney admitted.

car.en: a road vehicle with an engine and four wheels

beat-up.en: old and damaged from much use

affectionate.en: showing feelings of liking or love

Beast.en: a large dangerous animal; a name for something powerful

odometer.en: a device in a car that shows how many miles it has traveled

clunk.en: to make a low dull metallic sound

passenger.en: a person traveling in a vehicle but not driving

duct tape.en: a strong silver tape used for repairs

hood.en: the metal cover over a car's engine

remember.en: to bring back into your mind something from the past

gas.en: the liquid fuel used in cars (short for gasoline)

push.en: to use force to move something away from you

machine.en: a piece of equipment that does a particular kind of work

time machine.en: a device that can take you to the past or future (in stories)

library.en: a large collection of books; a lot of something

artifact.en: an object from the past that has historical interest

earring.en: a piece of jewelry worn on the ear

tie.en: a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck

dolphin.en: an intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish

diploma.en: an official document showing you finished school or university

culture.en: having a good knowledge of art, music, literature, etc.
